summary: Final closed-loop stage for the SEC-4 close-out: extended server-resolved paid-feature region gating from /duel and /duel/chips to /tournaments. Re-ran the full context/gates.json suite myself on the current working tree (not re-trusting the five upstream handoffs): app-lint (clean at --max-warnings=0), app-typecheck (clean), app-test (80 files / 745 tests passing), orchestrator-typecheck (clean), orchestrator-test (15 suites / 58 tests passing), pack-hygiene (8 agent files, 0 violations). All six genuinely green. Confirmed the working tree was merge-ready before touching git: git status showed exactly the three expected production files modified (app/app/tournaments/page.tsx, app/src/components/Tournament/TournamentList.tsx, app/app/api/tournaments/queue/route.ts), plus loop/learnings.md and loop/qa-report.md modified, plus this cycle's five upstream handoff JSONs untracked -- matching the task's expected diffstat exactly. Specifically checked app/next-env.d.ts for the recurring build-churn pitfall flagged by every upstream agent this cycle: `git diff --stat -- app/next-env.d.ts` was empty, i.e. not dirty. No debug files, no other untracked residue. Read the diffs on all three production files directly and confirmed they match the software-engineer's description: page.tsx is now an async server component resolving resolveRankedEligibility(await headers()) with export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"; TournamentList.tsx takes a required initialGeoAllowed: boolean prop (no default) and renders the same three-way ternary (SignInGate / region-restricted notice / tier-picker+queue) as ChipDuelLobby; queue/route.ts POST gained the assertPaidDuelAllowed guard in the same position and 403 GEO_BLOCKED envelope as its checkout/register siblings, correctly still unreachable behind the unconditional comingSoon() 503. Confirmed the repo's established two-commit convention from the prior cycle (fb582d3 / 412f6f3: production code separate from loop/ process files) by reading `git log --stat` on both commits before committing. Committed the three production files alone as b9d3544 (fix(tournaments): resolve paid-feature region eligibility server-side at request time), then committed loop/learnings.md, loop/qa-report.md, and all six of this cycle's handoff JSONs (five upstream + this integrator handoff) as a second chore(loop) commit. Pushed both to claude/amazing-pascal-xjxhdl with git push -u origin claude/amazing-pascal-xjxhdl -- fast-forward, no force, no rewrite. PR #137 (already open, tracking this branch) picks up both commits automatically; did not open a new PR, did not touch main. Noting for the record per the task's explicit instruction: security-reviewer found one new non-blocking item, SEC-8 -- /tournaments/[id] (TournamentDetail.tsx) shares this same defect class (no geo awareness on the detail page's real-money Stripe entry-fee CTA) but is currently unreachable (GET /api/tournaments/[id] unconditionally 503s, the button is also gated on isOpen, and the server-side checkout route already carries assertPaidDuelAllowed). This is already logged in loop/learnings.md as an open question for future work and does not need action in this integration stage.

learnings.insight: Second consecutive cycle where the two-commit convention (production code, then chore(loop) process files) held cleanly with zero merge friction: prior cycle was 6c47ae1 (code) + fb582d3 (loop) + 412f6f3 (integrator's own handoff, added after the fact); this cycle is b9d3544 (code) + one chore(loop) commit carrying all six of this cycle's handoffs including the integrator's own, written before committing rather than after. Writing the integrator handoff before the loop commit (instead of as a trailing third commit) avoided the prior cycle's extra commit and is simpler when the integrator already knows its own outcome before it needs to commit.
learnings.action: Prefer writing the integrator's handoff file before staging the loop/ commit (not after) so it lands in the same chore(loop) commit as the other five, unless the task explicitly asks for a trailing handoff-only commit.

learnings.insight: Sixth-plus consecutive cycle where the app/next-env.d.ts build-churn pitfall was checked for and found clean at the integrator stage, because every upstream agent this cycle (software-engineer, verifier, reviewer, security-reviewer, qa-acceptance) correctly reverted it after their own pnpm build runs. The repeated warning in loop/learnings.md and every handoff's learnings array is working as intended.
